title: session.create
description: The hub's (plan 032 §3.10): a new session in cwd, started in a host the hub spawns, and given prompt as its first prompt when there is one. It answers once the session has started: the session as the roster lists it, read fresh, and what became of the prompt. Neither session-scoped nor mutating: requestId is its idempotency — a repeat with the same params answers the first call's result, or joins it while it runs, also after a hub restart while the session's host lives; with other params it is bad_request, reason request_conflict; a retry after the session has ended creates another. Bad params are bad_request; a host that fails to spawn or to become ready is unavailable, reason spawn_failed; a start that fails or takes over 60 s is not_accepting, reason start_failed, data.cause the host's first error line, and the hub stops that host; more than 16 creates in flight is unavailable, reason busy; a hub tearing down, unavailable, reason closing. A host answers unsupported, reason hub_only; the connection capability sessionCreate says a hub serves it. No agent binary is a client's to name: the host finds its own.

cwd.description: The session's directory: an absolute path to an existing directory.

prompt.description: The first prompt, sent once the session has started; absent for none.

provider.description: A provider id (cursor, grok, gx, native); absent for the hub's configured default, and with none configured the create is bad_request.

model.description: The model to start on (the host's --model); absent for the provider's default.

effort.description: The effort to start at, where the model offers one (the host's --effort); absent for the model's own.

fast.description: The fast setting to start with, where the model offers one (--fast or --no-fast); absent for the model's own.

prompt.description: What became of the first prompt: none was sent; the session took it; it was sent and its answer lost (the session may be working on it; a create joined after a hub restart says unknown too); the session refused it, and runs on, idle.

promptError.description: Beside refused, the session's refusal; beside unknown, why the answer was lost.
